instruction.text: Look at this weather forecast and select the correct endings for each sentence.

feedback.end: Great! A weather forecast tells us what kind of weather we should expect. This forecast tells us that the weather on Tuesday will be cold and cloudy.

instruction.text: You are checking the weather forecast for the next few days online. Answer the following questions about the forecast.

atoms.a: On which day will it be sunny and cloudy?
On which day will it be the hottest?
On which day will there be thunder and lightning?

feedback.finish: Great work! We can get weather forecasts online, on the radio and on TV.

instruction.text: This weather map shows the forecast for different areas of the United Kingdom on a day in August.

atoms.a: Select the area that got the coldest weather on this day.

feedback.correct: Great! The very north of the UK normally gets the coldest weather, especially in the mountains.

atoms.a: Select the area that got the warmest weather on this day.

feedback.correct: Brilliant! The very south of the UK normally gets warmer weather. That’s why lots of people go on holiday there.

atoms.a: Select the area near Manchester, where it will rain and be 19°C.

feedback.correct: Weather maps are most commonly used to help present the weather on television.
